stories.name: Vassal Soul
stories.intro: A ghostly clerk in Azorius robes glides out of an archive. Death did not end its service. It finds you in breach of an old statute and swoops to enforce it.
stories.win: The spirit bows and swears its service to you. The law allows it.
stories.lose: It rakes you with cold hands and returns to its archive.
stories.flee: You run past the archive door, and it does not pursue.

stories.name: Lyev Skyknight
stories.intro: A skyknight on a winged mount lands across your path. Her lance glows, and your pack freezes on your back. "Stand for inspection."
stories.win: She lowers her lance and salutes. She will ride with you now.
stories.lose: She pins you with light and writes you a fine.
stories.flee: You break the hold and hide in an alley until she flies on.

stories.name: Detention Sphere
stories.title: A sphere holds a prisoner
stories.text: A glowing sphere hangs in the middle of a square, humming. Inside it, a man floats, frozen in place. An Azorius clerk is searching the cobbles for a lost writ of detention. Without it, she cannot hold him for long.

outcome.text: You and the clerk sweep the square.

huge_success.text: You find the writ under a cart. She trusts you to carry it to New Prahv and gives you the sphere's key.

success.text: You find the writ. She asks you to carry it to New Prahv and gives you the key.

failure.text: You search until dark and find no sign of it. The clerk sends you off.

outcome.text: She hands you the writ with relief. "New Prahv will want to hear this."

choices.text: Leave the man to the law

outcome.text: You move on, and the sphere hums on.

stories.name: Azorius Keyrune
stories.title: A keyrune of the Senate
stories.text: A small carved key lies on a Senate step, shaped like a bird. As you pick it up, it stretches its wings and tries to fly. A clerk runs toward you, shouting that it is Senate property.

outcome.text: The clerk thanks you and says to keep it. You have shown more care for the law than its owner.
The keyrune settles back into stone.

stories.name: Azorius Guildgate
stories.text: A great white gate marks the road to the Senate, its arches carved with law. You can claim it for a tile you have walked.
